what_this_binds: the frozen designs, the reviewed code, the pinned inputs and the frozen R5 mapping, so that what ran can be named before it runs

environment.invocation: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --with numpy==2.5.3 --with scipy==1.18.1 --with pandas==3.0.6 --with anndata==0.13.4 python
environment.note: versions are pinned with == in every command, so a later resolution cannot substitute a newer build; uv.lock is hashed as well, though --no-project does not resolve through it

r5_mapping.frozen_before: any PRISM response value was summarized

commands_in_order.what: R5 mapping stage; already run and frozen
commands_in_order.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --with numpy==2.5.3 --with scipy==1.18.1 --with pandas==3.0.6 --with anndata==0.13.4 python experiments/03d_h3_reference_discordance.py --r5-stage mapping --data /Users/elliottower/Documents/GitHub/drug-perturbation-geometry/data --prism data/prism_19q4 --output results/03d_h3_reference_discordance

commands_in_order.what: rebuild from the GCTX on Modal, with cell identifiers and the consensus gene axis
reconstruction gate; both halves must pass or the analyses are void
commands_in_order.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --with numpy==2.5.3 --with scipy==1.18.1 --with pandas==3.0.6 --with anndata==0.13.4 python experiments/03e_reconstruction_gate.py --rebuilt results/03c_h3_sensitivity/gctx_rebuild --extraction /Users/elliottower/Documents/GitHub/drug-perturbation-geometry/data --cohort results/03_phenotype_projection/phenotype_projection_results.json --output results/03c_h3_sensitivity

commands_in_order.what: single-cell audit on Modal, for R0.3, R0.4 and R0.6

commands_in_order.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --with numpy==2.5.3 --with scipy==1.18.1 --with pandas==3.0.6 --with anndata==0.13.4 python experiments/03c_h3_sensitivity.py --bundle results/03c_h3_sensitivity/cohort_bundle.npz --manifest results/03c_h3_sensitivity/rebuild_manifest.json

commands_in_order.what: R0 to R7 and R5 response, in one invocation of the driver
commands_in_order.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --with numpy==2.5.3 --with scipy==1.18.1 --with pandas==3.0.6 --with anndata==0.13.4 python experiments/03d_h3_reference_discordance.py --r5-stage response --expected-mapping-sha256 152361cb3174a5fb7aae0229c3e3d049dc00d49d9e442925156a9fe0564b89d3 --data /Users/elliottower/Documents/GitHub/drug-perturbation-geometry/data --perturbseq data/scperturb/ReplogleWeissman2022_K562_essential.h5ad --replogle data/replogle2022 --prism data/prism_19q4 --single-cell results/03d_h3_reference_discordance/single_cell_audit.json --output results/03d_h3_reference_discordance
commands_in_order.note: the driver runs once. R0 to R7 and R5 are produced by this single invocation, so no module is computed twice under different invocation states

policies.nonfinite_bootstrap_replicate: cluster_bootstrap asserts every replicate is finite, so an undefined draw fails the run rather than propagating; the registration calls such a replicate invalidating
policies.gate_failure: a failed reconstruction gate voids the analyses registered against it

external_record.why: a file cannot authenticate its own mutable contents
external_record.how: this manifest's sha256 is written into the commit message that adds it and into the annotated tag h3-execution-freeze
